Being on holiday my own GP practice was not able to help and advised me to phone 111. They were able to help to a certain extent, but not completely satisfactorily. After visiting Wells Health Centre, they registered me as a temporary patient. Carried out the necessary tests and made an appointment for me to see a member of the medical staff on the same day. I received expert advice and was able to pick up my prescription from the practice dispensary. All in all the staff were exceptionally helpful and professional. If only all practices were like this the NHS would be a far better place.
Thank you all again.
Frank Henderson

( which I have done for many years, and visit this area of Norfolk once or even twice a year)
I had a bad barking cough that got worse, and being asthmatic did not help at all. I rang my GP surgery and got a locum who insisted I ring 111, which I did twice, get checked out, which was easier said than done. 111 were really no help at all they only posted 2 reports to my GP and no recommendations for some anti b which would have stopped my situation becoming worse.

48 hours later I was desperate and could not breathe at all, in fact I thought I was dying as I couldn’t talk very well and my heart was racing.

I had already rung up this lovely surgery ( which appears is maned by angels), and they made an appointment for me with a very kind doctor who recognised what I required.
They even looked after my little dog (Zebby), which is unheard of these days, as this was a big concern for me should I need to be sent to hospital.
With the meds prescribed I feel nearly back to my normal self. I am still coughing a little at night but nothing like the hacking for 7 hours for the past three days.

When I feel more like my normal self I will return to my own county Derbyshire
A MASSIVE THANKS TO SHEILA, DR HITCHCOCK, SUE THE PHARMACY LADY AND ALL THE STAFF THAT HELPED ME WITH MY DILEMMA- you guys are the tops

Why then when I "signed in" was I not informed that delays were apparent and maybe I should come back in 2 hours (allowing for half an hour each for the two infront of myself still) - I do not have that sort of time to waste.
There are instructions on the noticeboard of what to do if we (the patients) turn up late.   Yet no one has the common decency to explain to us (again the patients) that infact things are not going to plan and maybe we should re-appoint or come back later.
